home.heroTitle: Arkan: Your Platform for Professional Creativity
home.heroSubtitle: Use powerful AI tools to generate documents, reports, code, and more.
home.feature1Desc: Generate professional proposals and full reports from a simple idea.
home.feature2Desc: Describe the component you want, and let the AI write the code for you.
home.feature3Desc: Control users, AI agents, and export templates with ease.

summarizer.pageSubtitle: Enter a detailed description of your project, and the AI will generate a professional summary highlighting key aspects and technologies used.
summarizer.formDescription: Paste your project description here. The more detailed the description, the better the summary.
summarizer.formPlaceholder: Example: I built a task management app using FlutterFlow and Firebase. The app features a simple UI and advanced features like smart reminders and weekly reports...
summarizer.errorGeneral: An error occurred while generating the summary. Please try again.

reportGenerator.pageSubtitle: Start with an idea, generate a full project proposal, then generate each section of the final report individually.
reportGenerator.step1Desc: Write a brief description of your project idea. The clearer the idea, the better the proposal.
reportGenerator.step1Placeholder: e.g., A customer relationship management (CRM) system to improve sales efficiency and customer service.
reportGenerator.step1Error: An error occurred while generating the proposal. Please try again.
reportGenerator.step2Desc: This is the raw input for the AI agents. You can modify it if needed.
reportGenerator.step3Desc: Select a section or diagram to generate. You can edit the prompt for each item.
reportGenerator.actionsDesc: Export your outputs or start a new session.
reportGenerator.generationSuccessDesc: Successfully generated "{item}". You can view it below.
reportGenerator.tool_context_desc: Select other generated sections or diagrams to provide as context to the AI.
reportGenerator.errorInsufficientCredits: Insufficient credits. Please top-up your account.
